backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor defining a Product type and a featuredProducts Map containing 18 hardcoded products across categories (Laptops, Headphones, Accessories, Audio, Mobiles, Gaming Peripherals, Air Conditioners, TVs, Refrigerators, Water Purifiers, Streaming Devices, Microphones, Vacuum Cleaners) with titles, affiliate URLs, descriptions, categories, and prices.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features related to debugging and fixing the FeaturedProducts component to ensure all 18 products from the backend are fetched, returned by useQueries, and rendered without truncation or filtering issues.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing summaries of 16 frontend files, describing React components (ProductCard, FeaturedProducts, DealCard, Layout, etc.), hooks (useQueries, useActor), pages (HomePage, ProductDetailPage), and configuration files with extensive debugging capabilities and product image mappings.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color system, defining design tokens for background, foreground, borders, and component colors with warm tech palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag, title 'Tech Affiliate Hub', and script tag loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up TanStack Router with routes for home page and product detail page, wrapped in QueryClientProvider for React Query state management.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontal scrollable category filter component displaying category buttons with visual selection state, using gradient styling for selected categories and conditional rendering based on category count.
frontend/src/components/DealCard.tsx: Clickable deal card component with discount badges, INR pricing, navigation to product detail pages, comprehensive product image mapping for 18 featured products and 10 Today's Deals products, and consistent discount percentage calculation based on product title hash.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Featured products grid component with search and category filtering logic, extensive console debugging that tracks data flow from React Query through filtering to render, displaying loading states, error alerts, and empty states with visual log separators.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component providing header with logo, search bar, main content area, and footer with branding and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, title, category, price, discount badge, and buy button with navigation to product detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailsSe: Tabbed product details section showing overview, specifications, and features with category-specific technical information.
frontend/src/components/ProductReviews.t: Product reviews component displaying average ratings, star distribution, and individual customer reviews with verified badges and helpfulness counts.
frontend/src/components/SearchBar.tsx: Search input component with search icon, clear button, and controlled input for filtering products.
frontend/src/components/TodaysDeals.tsx: Today's deals section component that fetches, filters by category and search query, and displays deal cards with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook managing backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, automatically invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching featured products and today's deals from the backend actor, with extensive logging, retry logic, and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a warm tech color palette supporting light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page component displaying featured products, today's deals, category filters, and a hero section with search functionality and category-based filtering.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Product detail page that fetches and displays individual product information from URL params, including image mapping, price formatting, and navigation back to home.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH colors, container settings, animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for a tech affiliate marketing website (Techvixo) selling electronics with Amazon partnership. Documents 19 versions of development including features for product display, search, reviews, and branding, with a known issue of only 6 products displaying instead of 18 in the Featured Products section.
